ngos.name: Aashray Rural & Slum Upliftment Trust
ngos.tagline: Empowering underserved urban informal settlements with sustainable livelihoods and clean water
ngos.mission: To eradicate extreme poverty and generational vulnerability through grassroots skill development, clean drinking water access, and community micro-enterprises.
ngos.description: Founded in 2014, Aashray Trust works with over 35,000 families across 18 slum clusters. We operate mobile community centres, vocational tailoring and electrical repair hubs, and solar-powered community purification stations.

ngos.name: BrightPath Global Literacy Foundation
ngos.tagline: Democratizing foundational literacy & STEM education for rural children and girls
ngos.mission: Ensuring no child drops out of education due to poverty, lack of school infrastructure, or gender inequality by providing tech-enabled micro-libraries and scholarship sponsorships.
ngos.description: BrightPath builds solar-powered digital classrooms in off-grid rural schools. Over 180 schools have been equipped with open-source offline digital encyclopedias, interactive mathematics software, and reading kits.
ngos.tax_exempt_status: East Africa PBO Certified & US 501(c)(3) Partner
ngos.address: Kilimani Innovation Hub, Argwings Kodhek Rd

ngos.name: Arogya Community Health Initiative
ngos.tagline: Bringing preventative healthcare, maternal wellness, and telemedicine to remote villages
ngos.mission: Bridging rural healthcare deserts with mobile medical vans, trained frontline ASHA workers, telemedicine kiosks, and essential medicine drops.
ngos.description: Operating across 94 villages in semi-arid and tribal districts, Arogya provides free maternal checkups, pediatric immunization tracking, and chronic disease management directly at doorsteps.
ngos.leadership_contact: Dr. Rajeshwar Sen, Chief Medical Officer

ngos.name: GreenCanopy Urban Afforestation Guild
ngos.tagline: Restoring urban biodiversity, micro-forests, and community rainwater harvesting
ngos.mission: Combating urban heat islands and groundwater depletion through Miyawaki mini-forests, lake rejuvenation, and citizen-led urban tree nurseries.
ngos.description: GreenCanopy has planted over 140,000 native saplings with a 92% survival rate. We partner with schools, tech campuses, and municipal wards to turn barren wastelands into dense thriving biodiversity havens.

ngos.name: EqualAbilities Inclusion Network
ngos.tagline: Empowering youth with disabilities through assistive technology and digital careers
ngos.mission: Creating an inclusive world where disability is never a barrier to high-income employment, independent living, and dignified community participation.
ngos.description: EqualAbilities provides specialized screen-reader coding bootcamps, 3D-printed custom assistive prosthetic accessories, and corporate disability sensitization programs.

ngos.name: NourishNation Hunger Project & Food Rescue
ngos.tagline: Zero hunger through commercial food rescue and community nutrition hubs
ngos.mission: Rescuing surplus food from hotels, corporate cafeterias, and farms to feed vulnerable migrant workers, shelters, and malnourished children.
ngos.description: With a fleet of temperature-controlled vans, NourishNation redirects tons of edible food daily to registered community kitchens, saving landfill methane while serving warm, dignified meals.

projects.title: Clean Water Wells & Solar Micro-Grids for 5 Informal Settlements
projects.tagline: Bringing potable drinking water and reliable solar lighting to 12,000 residents
projects.description: Residents of these five peri-urban informal settlements spend up to 3 hours daily waiting in line for unsafe tanker water. This initiative installs 5 deep-bore solar community water filtration kiosks and 60 rooftop solar streetlamps, operated sustainably by women's self-help groups.
projects.impact_target: Provide uninterrupted clean drinking water to 2,400 households and prevent waterborne disease.

projects.title: Solar STEM Micro-Labs for 25 Rural Schools
projects.tagline: Equipping 6,000 rural students with offline digital tablets, science kits, and mentor sessions
projects.description: Rural primary and secondary schools in the Rift Valley lack electricity and internet access. This project delivers ruggedized, solar-rechargeable digital literacy kits packed with preloaded Khan Academy, Wikipedia, and Python playgrounds.
projects.impact_target: Boost math and scientific literacy by 45% among 6,000 students, with 55% girl participation.

projects.title: Maternal Ultrasound & Telemedicine Van for Remote Tribal Hamlets
projects.tagline: Life-saving prenatal screening and specialist doctor tele-consults on wheels
projects.description: High maternal mortality in remote hilly villages is often caused by late detection of high-risk pregnancies and severe anemia. Our customized 4WD medical van travels to 22 remote villages every month.
projects.impact_target: Perform 3,200 prenatal scans, detect high-risk complications early, and distribute 15,000 iron & folic acid kits.

projects.title: Miyawaki Urban Forests & Lake Wetland Restoration
projects.tagline: Creating 10 native bio-diverse micro-forests to restore groundwater and cooling in urban heat corridors
projects.description: Rapid concrete expansion has caused groundwater levels to plummet. GreenCanopy is converting 5 acres of abandoned municipal dump yards into dense native Miyawaki micro-forests with 50+ indigenous tree species.
projects.impact_target: Plant 35,000 native trees, sequester 450 metric tons of CO2 annually, and recharge 40 million litres of groundwater.

impact_stories.title: From Toxic Arsenic Groundwater to Safe Solar RO: Darbhanga Ward 12 Transformation
impact_stories.before_description: High turbidity open wells with arsenic levels 3.8x above WHO safety limit. Children suffered from frequent gastrointestinal infections and chronic waterborne illnesses.
impact_stories.after_description: Installed a 5,000 LPD solar-powered reverse osmosis station with automated mineral remineralization and 24/7 smart RFID community water dispensing.

impact_stories.title: Reviving Delhi NCR Urban Wasteland into a 12,000-Tree Dense Native Miyawaki Forest
impact_stories.before_description: Construction debris dumping ground with compacted alkaline soil, zero bird nesting activity, and severe PM10 dust emission into nearby neighborhoods.
impact_stories.after_description: Decompacted soil with organic biomass, planted 42 native species at 3 plants/m² density. Self-sustaining multi-layered canopy reached 14 feet height with active biodiversity.

impact_stories.title: Mobile Computer Lab Bringing Coding & STEM to 420 Village Girls in Barmer
impact_stories.before_description: Zero access to digital devices. Girls had to walk 9 km to nearest cyber cafe for scholarship and board exam forms, resulting in heavy female dropout rates.
impact_stories.after_description: Established 20-workstation solar powered digital classroom with Python curriculum, robotics kits, and offline Wikipedia mirrors directly in the village school.

impact_stories.title: Mobile Telemedicine Clinic Delivering Preventative Healthcare Across 14 Tribal Hamlets
impact_stories.before_description: Isolated villages situated 35 km away from the nearest sub-district hospital with zero prenatal diagnostic equipment or maternal health checkups.
impact_stories.after_description: Deployed customized 4x4 diagnostic van equipped with portable sonography, ECG, automated biochemistry analyzers, and satellite broadband telemedicine.
